main_body: Fern foliage cluster sitting in a half-round terracotta pot
top_band: Pot column x=7: dark rim row 9, a single light peach row 10 (#f8c090), then the mid-brown front from row 11. No soil or opening ellipse is visible, so the pot has no top band.
evidence: The pot is the main supporting volume. In the column scan it has only a 1-row light rim (row 10) under a dark outline row, and the body below is a front face (rows 11-14). The pot mouth is not shown as an ellipse and no soil surface is visible, so this is the 'rim only' failure from the guide. The leaves are a rounded mass with no horizontal surface of their own. The pot reads as a bowl seen from the front.

style.evidence: The candidate has 12 distinct colours against 427 and 567 for the references, and it is smaller than one tile. The leaves use about 4 greens (dark, mid, light, highlight) and the pot about 4 browns, short of Beodeul's 5-6 steps. Outlines are tinted dark green and dark brown, which is good, and flat-fill coverage is 0%. But there are no leaf clumps or per-leaf variation, the pot has little grain, and the whole piece is thinner and flatter than the reference trees, so it does not hold up beside them.
